pairs.evidence: scripts/census/run-census.mjs:16 The context is a ported rule engine that ratchets library-adoption rules. Searching scripts/census for translat, next-intl, messages/ and pseudo found nothing (the only 'i18n' hit is a library-index.json entry title, and the only 'locale' hits are localeCompare), so no translation storage, movement or serving happens here.

pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: features/graph/catalogParity.test.ts:20 The parity test lists the locales by hand (`cs`, `en`) instead of deriving them from `locales` in lib/i18n/config.ts. A third registered language would silently escape the graph-catalog coverage check, which is the 'convenience copy' shadow registry the technique names as a defect.

techniques.evidence: features/graph/catalogParity.test.ts:20 Hand-enumerated locale list in the catalog-coverage test. By contrast, graphLoader.ts BOOL_LABEL is typed Record<Locale, …> and so does derive from the registry.
features/graph/graphLoader.ts:872 An unregistered locale falls back to canonical cs. There is no derived store and no per-unit fallback here.
features/graph/getPermalinkData.ts:56 This is a permalink content hash pinned to the canonical locale, not a translation cache. It is also a literal language code where defaultLocale could be used.
